observing.naked_eye: Visible as an elongated misty patch from a dark site; use averted vision when skyglow is present.
observing.binoculars: Under a dark sky, look for a faint diffuse glow with a brighter central concentration; sky transparency is crucial.
observing.telescope: Begin at low power to secure the galaxy, then increase magnification moderately to examine the core, elongation, and any visible structure.
